head: codex/5614-secret-scanning-fixtures
title: [security] Remove AWS key literal from redaction fixture
body:
Closes #5614

Removes the AWS temporary access-key-shaped literal reported by secret-scanning alert #1 while preserving the exact runtime sanitizer test through fragment-based construction. No AWS access or credential handling is involved.

Focused sanitizer and artifact-finalizer contracts pass, the tracked-source pattern scan is clean, and bounded security review found no actionable issues. After merge, alert #1 will be resolved explicitly as test-only.
